task: Use the key to open the door, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause R1 (hard Existence(door_open)) is redundant. The other hard rules (Precedence(has_key, door_open), Existence(at_goal), Precedence(door_open, at_goal)) already enforce that door_open must occur in any successful run, so an explicit Existence(door_open) repeats what is already implied. Remove the redundant Existence(door_open) clause.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(has_key) clause is redundant because the two hard Precedence clauses (has_key before door_open and door_open before at_goal) already force has_key to occur. A redundant Existence clause violates compactness rule 6. Remove the hard Existence(has_key) clause; the remaining Precedence and Existence(at_goal) clauses correctly capture the task.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(at_goal) ensures the goal, and the hard Precedence clauses correctly enforce acquiring the key before opening the door and opening the door before reaching the goal, matching the task description.

The key must be obtained before the door is opened.
